dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: A soft bed, fluffy pillows, cool, smooth blankets and sheets... It's enough to make you never want to leave again...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Wait, no, I can't fall asleep just yet... First, I need to eat my favorite dessert until I'm just over half-full, then get my hands and feet all toasty and warm by the furnace, and finish off with half a glass of water...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: If I do all of that, I'm sure my dreams will be as sweet as the fruit from my orchard, hehe...
